summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Board of Trustees declared a monthly dividend of $0.225 per common share on October 5, 2026. The distribution is payable on or about November 25, 2026 to holders of record as of the October 30, 2026 close, with shareholders able to elect cash or shares under the distribution reinvestment plan. No advisor, premium, stake, or strategic transaction is referenced. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation; the arbitrage angle focuses only on dividend capture timing.
